name: Lucien Morsandre
original_name: ルシアン・モルサンドル
source:
He came to England from his headquarters in France and is the head of Libra, a collective of curse-bearers.  

He has both financial and political power, as well as a majesty that makes others want to follow him.  Behind the scenes, he's constantly working to accomplish his endless plots.

The noble and composed Lucien gets close to the curse-bearers and you for the sake of accomplishing a certain "mission"--

Organization: Libra
Fairy Tale Curse: Faust and Mephistopheles

[Translated from official in-game profile]
